candidate_observations.address: 2a Alpha Street North, Slough, Berkshire, SL1 1RB
observed_facts: SJS Holdings Ltd, company 12106821, is active and pays £20,500 under an assigned fifteen-year restaurant lease from 12 July 2013, backed by an authorised guarantee agreement from SKVP (Slough) Limited.
The self-contained one-bedroom flat pays an annualised £15,300 under a 24-month AST from 20 September 2025.
The £35,800 headline therefore mixes the restaurant covenant with short residential income.
Earlier permission P/07171/005 for an additional residential unit has lapsed.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The AST was not represented as long-dated corporate income. The lapsed permission was not treated as live consent and no additional-flat rent, development value or post-July-2028 restaurant income was inferred.

candidate_observations.address: Units 1 to 3 St Michael's Church, High Street, Stamford, Lincolnshire, PE9 2AW
candidate_observations.status: Sold Post; price unpublished; headline rent £173,750
observed_facts: The £173,750 total comprises Nationwide Building Society at £63,750, Boots Opticians Professional Services Limited at £64,000 and Stamford V.E. Limited at £46,000.
Nationwide's five-year lease from 12 September 2023 contains a tenant break on 11 September 2026; the outcome is not published.
Boots Opticians, company 06779221 and active, may break on 1 July 2027.
The Vision Express lease runs without a tenant break to 1 December 2029, while the final sale price remains unpublished.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The headline was not represented as one covenant or one uniform term. No break outcome, renewal or sale price was inferred, and Nationwide's branch promise was not treated as a lease guarantee.

candidate_observations.status: Withdrawn Prior; price unpublished; published headline rent £78,600
observed_facts: The £78,600 published total comprises two retail rents of £6,600 and £13,200 plus five annualised residential AST rents totalling £58,800.
Four of the five published AST terms expired between May and August 2026 and the fifth expires on 2 September 2026; no renewals are published.
The £13,200 retail lease ends on 13 August 2026, while the £6,600 retail lease runs to 1 August 2029 with an August 2027 review.
Companies House confirms the exact active tenant identity as Bespoke Roof Safety Ltd, company 10998010, correcting the source footnote's conflicting 18998010 variant.
candidate_observations.guardrail: Expired or near-expiry AST rents were not treated as continuing current income. The aggregate was not represented as one covenant, no renewal or withdrawal price was inferred and the official company number was used instead of the typographical variant.

candidate_observations.address: Ann Summers, 50/50A Week Street, Maidstone, Kent, ME14 1RR
observed_facts: Ann Summers Ltd, company 01034349, is active and occupies under a term ending 27 November 2028.
The contractual structure is a base rent of £48,969.54 plus turnover rent equal to 12% of net sales.
The displayed £59,428 is the average annual rent received from April 2022 to March 2025, rather than a fixed contractual base rent.
The first floor is not currently used by the tenant and residential conversion or an additional floor remains subject to consents.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The historic average was not represented as guaranteed fixed future rent. No turnover projection, planning permission, upper-floor rent or development value was inferred.

candidate_observations.address: Côte Brasserie, 102-106 High Street, Esher, Surrey, KT10 9QJ
observed_facts: Côte Restaurant Group Ltd, company 12873009, is active and pays £105,000 under a 25-year restaurant lease from 24 October 2011.
The lease runs to October 2036 and the next five-yearly upward-only open-market review is 24 October 2026.
The interest is a 999-year virtual freehold from 23 August 2016 at peppercorn ground rent.
The property was Withdrawn Post and no sale price is published.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No October 2026 review uplift or sale price was inferred. Peppercorn rent was not counted as income and general company charges were not treated as evidence of default at this property.

candidate_observations.address: HSBC, 2-6 Gallowtree Gate and 1 and 3 Humberstone Gate, Leicester, LE1 1DA
observed_facts: HSBC UK Bank plc, company 09928412, is active and occupies the 11,807-square-foot bank building.
The extended lease runs without breaks to 6 July 2031 at £200,000 per annum.
A twelve-month half-rent period began on 24 June 2025, with the seller topping up the shortfall from completion until that period ended.
The property sold for £2,360,000.
candidate_observations.guardrail: Seller top-up was distinguished from tenant-paid contractual rent and was not double-counted. The expired concession was not carried forward and general HSBC charges were not treated as property-specific default.

candidate_observations.address: The First Edition PH, 50-54 Bank Street, Kilmarnock, Ayrshire, KA1 1ER
observed_facts: Stonegate Pub Company Limited, company FC029833, is active and pays £68,000.
The heritable public-house lease runs without breaks to 20 December 2041.
The next five-yearly review is 21 December 2026.
The property was Withdrawn Prior and no sale price is published.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No December 2026 review uplift or sale price was inferred. The overseas-company status was recorded without converting it into unsupported covenant strength or weakness.

candidate_observations.address: 20-22 French Gate, Doncaster, South Yorkshire, DN1 1QQ
candidate_observations.status: Sold £312,500; retail rent £33,000; upper floors vacant
observed_facts: Everyday Lending Limited, company 05850869, is active and pays £33,000 under a ten-year retail lease from 22 December 2017.
The retail lease ends on 21 December 2027 and the self-contained upper offices are vacant.
Planning reference 24/0255/FUL granted consent on 21 July 2025 for conversion of the upper offices to four two-bedroom flats.
A separate application 24/02502/FUL sought a reconfigured five-flat scheme; the listing does not state that this later application was granted.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The four-flat consent was not expanded to five flats. Vacant upper floors received no income, and no completed conversion, residential value or post-December-2027 rent was inferred.
